events.headline: IRAN TO ANNOUNCE RESTRICTED ZONE OUTSIDE STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei says Tehran will announce a restricted zone around the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: NORTH KOREA DEPLOYS WARSHIP ‘CAPABLE OF ANNIHILATING RETALIATORY STRIKES’
events.detail: Leader Kim Jong Un says vessel will form part of Pyongyang's nuclear response system, strengthen naval forces.

events.headline: IRAN WAR LIVE: TEHRAN TO ANNOUNCE HORMUZ ROUTE; ISRAEL KILLS 11 IN LEBANON
events.detail: Move comes as Iran's top negotiator warns of heavier responses to new attacks after US strikes on Iranian oil tankers.

events.headline: IRAN WARNS OF 'FASTER, HEAVIER, MORE PAINFUL RESPONSE' TO US ATTACKS
events.detail: The comments came a day after Washington said it had struck Iranian oil tankers in response to Tehran's attacks on US warships in the region.

events.headline: US MISSILE STRIKE SINKS IRANIAN TANKER (VIDEO)
events.detail: An Iranian oil tanker has sunk in the Gulf of Oman after being attacked by American forces, US Central Command has said Read Full Article at RT.com
